content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello! I hope you are having a great week. I am writing to share a few proposed updates to the agreement before we proceed with signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on ownership, the current terms transfer rights to the work product immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment. I propose updating this so that ownership transfers upon full payment of all fees due under the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment milestones, a portion of the payment is tied directly to formal acceptance, which creates uncertainty. I propose modifying this so the amount is payable within thirty days following delivery, unless a good faith notice of non-conformance is provided. Please let me know if these modifications work for you. Best regards,
